summary: אָרַר means to pronounce a curse. In Genesis 3:14 Yahweh addresses the serpent as אָרוּר, “cursed,” and declares that it will go on its belly and eat dust all its life.

senses.definition: To pronounce a curse on someone. The passive participle describes the one under the curse.

evidence.note: Yahweh says אָרוּר אַתָּה, “cursed are you,” to the serpent because of what it has done. Going on its belly and eating dust are the consequences he declares.
